summary: Verdict: clean. Both round-1 majors are fixed with real proofs. coneSlicePast at BTZ points is proved by sliceAt_past_of_mem_axis, so coneSlicePast_Y and coneSlicePast_YBTZ hold at every point, unconditionally and in LocalModel's verbatim shape. K = J⁺(w) ∩ {τ + r = c} is non-empty, and Γ is a genuine Cauchy surface of N in the library's sense. Diamonds form a basis (diamonds_basis), and from it the open-diamond neighbourhood basis and the Alexandrov topology equal to the topology are also proved. The Isom(E0) generators are ChartIso, and SingularFlatAxioms is bundled with push-up as its only disclosed input. The file builds cleanly, with 0 sorry and only the standard axioms on all 310 declarations. The DEC-33 gate is respected, there are no name clashes and no marks, and the single ledger row is correctly partial and unmarked. Three minors remain, each disclosed and owned by WP-39f: the groupoid assembly of chartIso_mem, local push-up / CausallyOpenFuture, and the identification of the transported BTZE0 causality and locus with Model/Rigid's.
